description: Hills lookout cell at fog-noon (goal.md AD-2): the whole block below, a natural Producer vantage. Marble text prompt (+ key art once approved) → spz 100k/500k/full + collider + pano + cell.json.

inputs.text: Standing at a hillside lookout above a Bay Area neighborhood at foggy noon. A gravel turnout with a low wooden fence and a coin-operated viewer, eucalyptus trees and dry golden grass, a winding road dropping down the hill, the whole block of houses and the coastline below dissolving into thick fog, soft diffuse overcast light, muted colors, damp asphalt, a weathered bench. Photorealistic, physically plausible light, quiet and wistful. No people, no cars.
